findings.summary: Multiple directories with 20+ files indicate potential hub modules creating coupling issues
findings.evidence: Flat directories with many files detected
findings.suggestion: Consider splitting large directories into subpackages

findings.summary: Mixed naming conventions - some files use snake_case, others vary
findings.suggestion: Standardize on snake_case for Python files

findings.summary: Mixed error handling - some functions throw exceptions, others return None
findings.evidence: Catch blocks that only log errors found
findings.suggestion: Standardize error handling with custom exceptions

findings.summary: Some facade modules with re-exports but no concrete implementations
findings.suggestion: Remove unused re-exports or ensure they're imported

findings.summary: Some modules may have unused imports
findings.evidence: sys.path mutations at import time detected
findings.suggestion: Use proper relative imports or package installation

findings.summary: Multiple production modules lack test coverage
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests for critical paths

findings.summary: Several demo and prototype files may not be production-ready
findings.evidence: Files with if __main__ but no imports
findings.suggestion: Move demo code to scripts/ directory

findings.summary: Orphaned files with entry points but no importers
findings.suggestion: Move standalone scripts to scripts/ folder

findings.summary: Complex nested directory structure may benefit from simplification
findings.evidence: Multiple levels of nesting with mixed purposes

findings.summary: Some modules have complex initialization dependencies
findings.suggestion: Use dependency injection instead of globals

findings.summary: Some functions could be simplified for readability
findings.suggestion: Break down large functions into smaller units

findings.summary: Mixed design patterns across the codebase
